title: Chess, But SPC-096 Hides In the Fog
summary: Fog-of-war chess vs Stockfish: the player only sees squares his pieces attack. A neutral SCP-096 (Shy Guy) hides on a random empty square in ranks 3-6 (24 possible squares). Any piece (either colour) that attacks/'looks at' the Shy Guy's square is captured by it - Shy Guy jumps to that piece. Game 1 is lost instantly when the narrator's first move exposes a line onto the Shy Guy, which then takes his king. Game 2 lost; game 3 won when Shy Guy captures the black king after the engine attacked it.
rules: Fog of war for the player: only squares currently attacked by your pieces are visible (pieces start behind pawns, so initially only pawn-attacked squares).
Stockfish plays with full information of the board but presumably not of the Shy Guy [inferred].
SCP-096 spawns hidden on a random empty square of ranks 3-6 (24 squares).

Whenever any piece attacks the Shy Guy's square (its movement/capture lines touch it), the Shy Guy captures that piece (moves onto it), revealing itself; it then remains there and keeps capturing anything that attacks it.
Its captures are audible/visible as an extra move after Black's move (used for deduction).
Shy Guy capturing a king ends the game (lost game 1, won game 3).
win_condition: Checkmate Stockfish or have Shy Guy capture the black king.
